modalities.evidence: EEG and EOG channels were acquired

output.population: 19 younger adult subjects (8 male, 11 female, ages 20-40 years) and 30 older adult subjects (11 male, 19 female, ages 49-73 years), cognitively intact with normal or corrected hearing and vision
output.summary: EEG recordings from younger and older adults performing an interleaved dual-oddball audio-visual attention shift task, collected to study how aging affects selective attending and responding to auditory and visual stimulus differences.
